Name: Abia, Son of Rehoboam
Summary: Son of Rehoboam and king in the line of Judah after him.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:10: Son of Rehoboam and king in the line of Judah after him.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abia stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
